visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a wide shot of a family group—a man, a woman with her back to the camera, and two young girls—relaxing on a large brown picnic mat spread across a lush green lawn. A white tent with a cartoon animal face stands behind them. Food containers filled with fruit and sandwiches are arranged in the center. A small girl in an orange dress and black skirt picks up a green juice carton and drinks from it. (2) The scene shifts to an open grassy field under a bright blue sky. A young girl in a white t-shirt and pink pants runs towards a soccer ball and kicks it. A man in a dark shirt and shorts watches her from a distance. The sunlight is bright and natural, casting long shadows on the grass. (3) In a closer shot on the lawn, the two young girls play with a yellow plastic circular ring. They take turns tossing the toy to each other. A stroller is visible in the background near the picnic mat. The girls' movements are playful and energetic as they interact with the toy. (4) A young girl wearing a brown shirt with a tomato graphic and patterned green pants walks across the grass, holding a woman's hand. She stops and points toward something in the distance, her expression curious. The background features scattered large rocks and lush green trees under a clear afternoon sun. (5) The same young girl in the tomato shirt stands alone on the grass, folding her arms across her chest with a serious expression. She then stretches her arms back and looks up, appearing to mimic an exercise. Her older sister joins her, copying the stretching motion with a wide smile. (6) As evening approaches, a girl sits in a stroller being pushed along a paved park path. She holds a blue flower-shaped pinwheel that spins in the air. The lighting is dimmer, indicating dusk. The video concludes with a yellow screen featuring a simple cartoon illustration of a family and the text 'CUI'S FAMILY LIFE.'

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio track opens with a cheerful, mid-tempo acoustic guitar melody featuring bright strumming. A male voice speaks in a friendly, enthusiastic tone, introducing the park visit. Faint paper rustling sounds accompany the visual of food preparation. (2) The narrator continues with a conversational delivery style, listing different picnic foods. The background music remains constant in the mix. A child's muffled vocalization is heard in the background, suggesting high-arousal excitement within the family group. (3) A sudden high-pitched shout of 'Kick!' signals a transition. This is immediately followed by the percussive sound of a ball being struck. The acoustic environment shifts to an open field with a light wind floor. The music continues with its upbeat rhythmic drive. (4) A metallic or plastic clinking sound occurs as a toy hits the ground. High-pitched child laughter is prominent. The narrator's voice remains dominant, exhibiting a teasing and warm inflection as he interacts with the children playing with the yellow ring. (5) The acoustic scene is dominated by a toddler's high-pitched, clear voice repeating 'Flower.' The narrator responds with a lower-pitched, gentle correction. The BGM maintains a steady major-key tonality, providing a happy emotional backdrop to the dialogue. (6) Grunting sounds and effortful vocalizations from a child are heard, followed by more adult laughter. The music stays consistent in volume. The recording quality is clear, with a high signal-to-noise ratio, despite the outdoor setting. (7) The final phase features the narrator's voice softening as he mentions the time of day. A child mimics a howling sound with high pitch variability. The BGM concludes with a short, melodic electronic jingle over a flat graphic screen.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video documents a wholesome family day out at Taichung Metropolitan Park. It aims to share the joy of simple activities like picnicking, playing soccer, and interacting with young children in a natural setting. The use of cheerful music and variety-show style subtitles enhances the warm, domestic appeal.
